questions.q: Which of the following is the primary concern raised by Dr. Amara Boateng in her address to the summit?
options: That vehicle emissions have become the single largest source of particulate matter across West African cities.
That her network of low-cost sensors proved far too expensive for the eleven cities that installed it.
That global datasets have consistently overstated the level of dust pollution in African cities.
That Africa's scarcity of monitoring stations leaves its cities relying on pollution models built for other regions.
That West African governments have refused to purchase air-quality sensors from foreign suppliers.
questions.solution:
Read the stem and test each choice against the stated condition. The keyed choice is option 4, "That Africa's scarcity of monitoring stations leaves its cities relying on pollution models built for other regions."; it is the only option that satisfies the question.

**Answer: That Africa's scarcity of monitoring stations leaves its cities relying on pollution models built for other regions.**
